Context: 4. Seniority of Surplus Staff and Re-deployment

- 4.5.2. Recruitment through Staff Selection Commission.If Sportspersons are recruited by the department itself through a selection conducted by the Staff Selection Commission, they should be placed junior to candidates recommended by the Commission. The inter se seniority of sportspersons will be in the order of their selection.
- 4.6 Seniority of Persons appointed on Compassionate Grounds.-
